author: Nerdstalgic
description:
When Entourage first premiered Ari Gold was everything audiences hated about Hollywood. Ruthless, manipulative, and willing to do whatever it took to close a deal, he seemed destined to be the show's primary antagonist.

But something wasn't working.

Instead of doubling down on Ari's sleazy reputation, Entourage completely reinvented him. By revealing the loyal husband, devoted father, and fiercely protective mentor beneath the insults and outbursts, Ari Gold evolved into the emotional core of Entourage.

title: How Entourage SAVED Ari Gold
